title: vsftpd 2.3.4 Backdoor Command Execution
description: Malicious backdoor payload in vsftpd-2.3.4 tarball triggers root shell on port 6200 when a smiley face is sent.
fix: Immediately replace vsftpd 2.3.4 with upstream 3.0.5 or modern secure distribution package.

title: ProFTPD mod_copy Arbitrary File Copy
description: mod_copy module permits unauthenticated attackers to copy local files using CPFR/CPTO commands.
fix: Upgrade ProFTPD to 1.3.5a or disable mod_copy in proftpd.conf.

title: OpenSSH RegreSSHion RCE Flaw
description: Signal handler race condition in sshd on glibc-based Linux allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root.
fix: Upgrade OpenSSH to 9.8p1 or newer, or set 'LoginGraceTime 0' in sshd_config as interim workaround.

title: OpenSSH User Enumeration
description: sshd user enumeration vulnerability due to timing discrepancies in authentication request handling.
fix: Upgrade OpenSSH server package to version 7.7 or newer.

title: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal & RCE
description: Flaw in path normalization permits traversal to read arbitrary files or execute CGI scripts if mapped.
fix: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server immediately to 2.4.51 or higher.

title: Apache HTTP Server Incomplete Traversal Fix
description: Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 allowing path traversal and remote code execution.
fix: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to 2.4.51 or higher.

title: Nginx DNS Resolver Memory Overwrite
description: 1-byte off-by-one overwrite in DNS resolver code allows remote attackers to cause DoS or code execution.
fix: Upgrade Nginx to version 1.20.1 or 1.21.0 or newer.

title: Redis Lua Sandbox Escape (Debian/Ubuntu)
description: Packaging issue in Lua library allows attackers to escape sandbox and execute arbitrary system commands.
fix: Update redis-server via OS package manager and ensure Redis binds only to localhost with authentication.

title: Exim Return of the WIZ Command Execution
description: Improper validation of recipient addresses in deliver_message() allows remote execution as root.
fix: Upgrade Exim to 4.93 or newer immediately.
